diagnosticPrimary: baseline-1 is also the 12/5 diagnostic cell; the same saved run is reused.

stopping.rule: First checkpoint whose A-alone recruitment of refB is >=0.5 at both delays. Nothing else is consulted. Evaluate there and continue to 40 only for the curve.

requiredControls.prune-cross: forward <0.3 and below pre-prune; all four self half completions change by no more than 0.05 at both delays

acceptance.go: Every gated condition and required control passes on all three baseline seeds. Diagnostics and reported controls cannot change this decision.

controls.baseline: untrained = exact Stage 1g stop before association
controls.exposure: Controls evaluated at primary stop. Unpaired continuation proceeds to 40 separately for the dashed curve, with A then B each epoch, jitter 15 and 10-second gaps exactly as Stage 1g.
controls.hebbian: Native field.setFeatures({hebbian:false}) at the verified unlocked boundary; permanent for the phase and recorded in featureHistory.
controls.growth: Pool nextGrowthAt=1e12 at the boundary only.
controls.pruning: Native prune() on the union of surviving formed A-to-B and B-to-A edges; remove inactive references from source.synapses, preserving all other edges.

measurement.refs: Frozen Stage 1g cores; all Stage 2 gates and metrics use these exact IDs.
measurement.cross: Inclusive ref memberships: source in A and target in B, or reverse. Shared members can make an edge count in both directions; prune the union once. Report shared counts explicitly.
measurement.contemporaneous: 80% presence in last ten responses. Paired whole-trial activity is assigned to both co-presented cues, with no causal attribution; never used for gates.
measurement.prediction: Stage 1e earliest continuous-time afferent model, combined A/B schedule per paired trial, actual afferent and recurrent delays, lag 0..0.32 s, source after edge birth; predicted counts distinguished from observed positive native STDP events.
measurement.phases: Reproduce each seed in an unlocked field once, validate exact cores/edges/weights/full export/trials/draws, then native DevelopmentSession checkpoint/restore for identical independent controls. No unlocking or snapshot rewriting.
measurement.randomness: Dedicated association LCG: seed XOR 0xd1b54a35. Unpaired resumes the Stage 1g jitter stream after formationEpoch*16 draws. Every draw is saved.
measurement.figures: Per baseline seed: forward, reverse, min A half, min B half and C spillover; primary solid, unpaired dashed. Show both delays when they differ.
